verdict.rationale: Jira's features page directly claims you can keep work up to date by tracking progress from tools including Figma, with AI assistance, and that Rovo connects Figma assets to work items. However, this is a single marketing-level mention with no documentation of how status is actually updated from inside the design tool. missing for 10: documented Figma-side workflow for updating Jira issue status without leaving the design app, details on which status/field changes are supported, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
